Container.Name: Mashina
Container.Overview:
MASHINA is a modern, self-hosted vehicle maintenance tracker and car logbook. Keep service history, repairs, mileage, fuel, and expenses on your own server with a mobile-friendly interface (PWA) and private local storage.
[b]Key Features:[/b] - [b]Vehicle History & Profiles:[/b] Photos, ownership, mileage, service records, replacement parts, and private documents. - [b]Fuel & Expense Tracking:[/b] Itemized costs, receipts, vehicle defaults, and full-to-full consumption analytics. - [b]Interactive Damage Map:[/b] Visual body damage tracking with before/after photos and linked repair history. - [b]Tire Management:[/b] Mounting history, DOT manufacture codes, and dated tread depth measurements. - [b]Local OCR Receipt Scanning:[/b] Built-in Tesseract OCR for automatic receipt and invoice line-item extraction. - [b]Privacy First:[/b] SQLite with WAL, local attachments, full ZIP backup/restore, zero cloud dependencies or telemetry.
[b]IMPORTANT SETUP INSTRUCTIONS:[/b] 1. [b]Build Docker Image:[/b] Upstream currently provides source-only releases. Before installing, build the container image directly on your Unraid server terminal with: [code]docker build -t mashina:latest https://github.com/kosavan/mashina.git#main[/code] 2. [b]Directory Permissions:[/b] The container runs as non-root user (UID 10001:10001). Ensure write permissions on your appdata folder: [code]mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/mashina && chown -R 10001:10001 /mnt/user/appdata/mashina[/code] 3. [b]Create Admin User:[/b] Public sign-up is disabled. After the container starts, open the container terminal/console in Unraid and create your owner account: [code]/app/.venv/bin/python -m backend.cli create-admin[/code] (Or run [code]/app/.venv/bin/python -m backend.cli bootstrap[/code] and check [inline]appdata/mashina/.bootstrap-token[/inline]). 4. [b]Reverse Proxy & HTTPS:[/b] For remote mobile access and full PWA offline features, configure an HTTPS reverse proxy (e.g., Nginx Proxy Manager, Caddy, SWAG), set MASHINA_ORIGIN to your HTTPS URL, and set MASHINA_SECURE_COOKIES=1.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port for the Mashina web interface (internal container port is 8000).

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Storage for SQLite database, uploaded photos, receipts, documents, and backups. NOTE: The container runs as non-root UID 10001:10001. Ensure this folder is owned by 10001:10001 (chown -R 10001:10001 /mnt/user/appdata/mashina).

Config.Name: Origin / Base URL
Config.Description: Public base URL for the application (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8088 or https://garage.yourdomain.com). Required for authentication, CSRF validation, and Web Push notifications.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to 1 if accessing Mashina through an HTTPS reverse proxy, or 0 if accessing directly over HTTP on your local network.

Config.Name: Backup Retention
Config.Description: Number of automated backup archives to keep inside /app/data/backups.

Config.Name: API & MCP Access
Config.Description: Enable scoped machine API and local Model Context Protocol (MCP) access (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled). Container restart required after changing.

Config.Name: VAPID Subject (Web Push)
Config.Description: Optional Web Push contact URI (e.g. mailto:you@example.com or your HTTPS URL). Defaults to MASHINA_ORIGIN if left blank.

Config.Name: Telegram Bot Token
Config.Description: Optional Telegram bot token for service and reminder notifications.
